<thought>To find the retrosynthetic template for a Friedel‑Crafts acylation, I will search the template catalog using a representative product (acetophenone) and criteria that a halide is broken and a ketone is formed in the forward reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccccc1C(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketone"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
